exposure: Mesenchymal stromal cell-derived extracellular vesicles (MEx) treatment
outcome: Abundance, surface marker repertoire, and cytokine profiles of utero-placental immune populations
cohort: Pregnant heme oxygenase-1 null (Hmox1-/-) and wild-type control female mice.
finding: MEx treatment in a mouse model of preeclampsia-like features significantly improved fetal loss, intrauterine growth restriction, placental spiral artery modification, and maternal preeclamptic stigmata by optimizing the intrauterine immune environment.
